n73f54e2b93.headline: Santander to Sell Poland Assets to Austria's Erste Group for $7.9 Billion -- 2nd Update
n73f54e2b93.summary: Banco Santander agreed to sell most of its Polish assets to Austria's Erste Group Bank for 7 billion euros. The deal continues a wave of dealmaking among European banks.
n73f54e2b93.why: Santander is a Spanish multinational bank with large retail and corporate operations across Europe and Latin America. Erste Group is an Austrian bank focused on Central and Eastern Europe.

impacts.name: Erste Group Bank
impacts.why: Erste Group is the buyer of the Polish assets for 7 billion euros.

nd215a83ce9.headline: S&P 500 snaps 9-session win streak after latest Trump tariff
nd215a83ce9.summary: U.S. stocks fell across the board on Monday, with the S&P 500 snapping its longest streak of gains in 20 years. The Dow slipped a quarter of one percent and the S&P 500 dropped six tenths of a percent.
nd215a83ce9.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US-listed companies and is the main benchmark for US equity performance.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The index fell after a new Trump tariff, ending its nine-session winning streak.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nd215a83ce9.why_moved: The decline followed a new Trump tariff, according to the report, which ended a nine-session run of gains.

n8e668f4e1d.headline: Money Fellows Raises $13M to Drive Financial Inclusion in Africa
n8e668f4e1d.summary: Money Fellows, an Egyptian fintech digital platform, has raised $13 million to enhance and upgrade its digital platform. The funding targets financial inclusion across Africa.
n8e668f4e1d.why: Fintech funding rounds signal investor appetite for digital payments and lending in underbanked African markets.

nf6070af5c4.headline: US Tariffs Push China’s Largest Wholesale Market to the Brink
nf6070af5c4.summary: Merchants in China's Yiwu wholesale market are cutting staff and warehouse space after the repeal of the US de minimis rule made cheap-parcel trade unprofitable. The article attributes the strain to US tariffs.
nf6070af5c4.why: Yiwu is one of China's largest small-commodity wholesale hubs, and its export volumes are a barometer for low-value trade with the US and other markets.

nda06ded892.headline: EU power grid needs trillion-dollar upgrade to avert Spain-style blackouts
nda06ded892.summary: Europe's ageing power grid and limited energy storage will require trillions of dollars of investment to handle rising green output and higher electricity demand. The article cites the risk of Spain-style blackouts.
nda06ded892.why: Grid spending drives demand for utilities, grid equipment makers and storage developers, and shapes the cost of the energy transition across Europe.

n197121d452.headline: Caputo hints at measures to incentivize dollar spending
n197121d452.summary: Argentina's economy minister Luis Caputo hinted at measures to incentivise dollar spending. He said the idea is that people can buy whatever they want without being asked for explanations.
n197121d452.why: Currency controls and dollar-spending rules shape the peso's value and capital flows in Argentina, a major emerging-market sovereign.

nb1e830b3c7.headline: Fortuna eyes Guinea investments after Burkina Faso exit, CEO says
nb1e830b3c7.summary: Canada's Fortuna Mining is eyeing expansion into Guinea after leaving Burkina Faso, where it faced regulatory instability and high security costs. The CEO told reporters in Dakar.
nb1e830b3c7.why: Fortuna is a Canadian gold miner with operations in West Africa, and its asset decisions depend on political and security risk. Gold producers' results are sensitive to gold prices and operating costs.

n2d45aebc42.headline: Greece’s Heating and Water Heater Subsidy Program Nears Application Deadline
n2d45aebc42.summary: Greece's heating and water heater subsidy programme is approaching its application deadline, with special provision for holders of unredeemed vouchers from the previous Recycle-Change Water Heater initiative.
n2d45aebc42.why: Government subsidy schemes influence household energy spending and demand for appliances and installation services.

n9678edd32e.headline: UBA Ghana delivers strong 2024 results; commits to innovation, inclusion, and sustainable growth
n9678edd32e.summary: United Bank for Africa Ghana reported robust financial and operational performance for 2024, according to the company. It cited resilience, innovation and sustainable growth.
n9678edd32e.why: UBA Ghana is a unit of the pan-African lender United Bank for Africa, and its results indicate banking-sector health in Ghana.

n7a387b671a.headline: Ringgit rises against greenback following govt response to impact from US reciprocal tariffs
n7a387b671a.summary: The ringgit ended higher against the US dollar on Monday, amid the government's response to the impact of reciprocal tariffs from the United States, an analyst said.
n7a387b671a.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its moves affect import costs, foreign investment and the country's trade-exposed exporters.

na8c2daa97c.headline: Air France, Lufthansa, others avoid Pakistan airspace amid India tensions
na8c2daa97c.summary: Air France and Lufthansa were among global carriers avoiding Pakistani airspace, according to airlines and flight-tracking websites, as tensions between the nuclear-armed neighbours rose.
na8c2daa97c.why: Air France-KLM and Lufthansa are major European airlines, and airspace closures force longer routes that raise fuel and operating costs.

nd14bbf8adf.headline: AK Study: Purchase Prices for Old Rental Buildings Have Risen Sharply Since 2000
nd14bbf8adf.summary: A study by Austria's AK chamber of labour found purchase prices for old Vienna rental buildings have risen sharply since 2000. AK economist Thomas Ritt said prices are out of control.
nd14bbf8adf.why: Residential property prices in Vienna affect Austrian housing affordability, rental returns and the banks that finance property purchases.

na430b96a96.headline: Cummins:  Q1 Earnings Snapshot
na430b96a96.summary: Cummins Inc. reported first-quarter earnings of $824 million, or $5.96 per share. The Columbus, Indiana-based engine maker's report was released on Monday.
na430b96a96.why: Cummins is a global maker of diesel and natural gas engines and power generation equipment, so its results reflect demand across trucking, construction and power markets.

n61ce74eabf.headline: Arab investments in Greece: The deals and the prospects
n61ce74eabf.summary: A bilateral workshop held under the Greek Ministry of Foreign Affairs, attended by the UAE Minister of Industry and Advanced Technology, examined Arab investments in Greece and their prospects.
n61ce74eabf.why: Foreign direct investment from Gulf states can fund infrastructure, energy and real estate projects in host economies. Greece has been a focus of such investment flows.

ne5c759c1fa.headline: Economists lower Malaysia's GDP growth forecast to 4.5%, remain confident in economy's resilience
ne5c759c1fa.summary: Economists lowered their 2025 Malaysian GDP growth forecast to 4.5% because of tariffs imposed by the United States, while remaining confident in the economy's resilience.
ne5c759c1fa.why: GDP forecasts guide expectations for corporate earnings, interest rates and the ringgit. Malaysia is a trade-exposed Southeast Asian economy, so US tariffs matter for its outlook.

nf979569082.headline: Adnoc Gas Posts Higher Net Income, Beats Views
nf979569082.summary: Adnoc Gas posted first-quarter net income of $1.27 billion, up 7%, beating market views. The Abu Dhabi-owned gas company reported the results on Monday.
nf979569082.why: ADNOC Gas is a state-owned gas producer in Abu Dhabi, part of the UAE's energy sector and a major supplier of gas and related products.

n7c2492e9d8.headline: A new chapter for TERNA Energy with Masdar at the helm
n7c2492e9d8.summary: A new chapter for TERNA Energy has begun with Masdar at the helm, led by Sultan Al Jaber, the UAE industry minister and Masdar chairman. The change follows a Masdar-linked transaction.
n7c2492e9d8.why: TERNA Energy is a Greek renewable energy producer, and Abu Dhabi's Masdar is a large global renewables investor.

n5c532f2e05.headline: Ireland's billion dollar 'tax mirage' could collapse under Trump
n5c532f2e05.summary: About $967 billion of intangible assets have been held in Ireland by multinational companies under tax avoidance schemes. The arrangements could collapse under Trump, according to Newstalk.
n5c532f2e05.why: Ireland has long attracted multinationals with low tax rates and intellectual property structures, so changes to these arrangements affect corporate tax revenue and foreign direct investment flows.

ne0723ba1c4.headline: Trump’s tariffs on non-US movies would be ‘a knock-out blow’ to UK film industry
ne0723ba1c4.summary: Trump said there will be a 100% tariff on movies produced in foreign lands entering the United States. The UK film industry is described as facing a knock-out blow from the measure.
ne0723ba1c4.why: Film production and distribution are significant export industries, and tariffs on imported films would reshape international production and distribution economics.

ncad267e44c.headline: Trump threatens 100% tariff on foreign-made films
ncad267e44c.summary: Donald Trump threatened a 100% tariff on foreign-made movies. Tax incentives have increasingly pushed film production out of California to other states and countries.
ncad267e44c.why: Film production is a major economic activity, and tariffs on foreign content could shift studio spending and production location decisions.

n198efe78f6.headline: India-UK trade pact talks may take more time as certain issues remain unresolved: Sources
n198efe78f6.summary: India and the UK continue negotiations on a free trade agreement, a bilateral investment treaty and a social security pact. Sources say critical issues remain unresolved, which may delay talks.
n198efe78f6.why: A India-UK trade agreement would reshape tariffs and investment flows between two major economies, affecting exporters and service providers.

n8dc20e705c.headline: Minister to urge agencies to cut red tape for SMEs
n8dc20e705c.summary: Enterprise Minister Peter Burke will meet the heads of 19 agencies and offices under his remit. He will ask them to review processes and obligations placed on small businesses.
n8dc20e705c.why: Small and medium enterprises make up most of Ireland's business base, so regulatory burden affects their costs and growth.

nbdcff9e67b.headline: Germany's CDU/CSU and SPD leaders sign coalition agreement in Berlin
nbdcff9e67b.summary: CDU leader Friedrich Merz, set to be sworn in as chancellor, said the three parties would "vigorously get to work" after signing the coalition agreement in Berlin.
nbdcff9e67b.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, so the stability and policy direction of its government shape fiscal, energy and trade expectations for European markets.

nc5f8cd5b4c.headline: Moody's Adjusts Thailand's Outlook: A Warning Sign the Economy Cannot Ignore
nc5f8cd5b4c.summary: Moody's adjusted Thailand's outlook, flagging concerns over rising debt and weakening fiscal strength in the economy.
nc5f8cd5b4c.why: Moody's is a major credit rating agency, and outlook changes on sovereign debt influence borrowing costs and investor demand for Thai government bonds.

n32e28a20b7.headline: GE2025: Ruling party’s strong showing signals flight to safety and a vote for policy continuity, say analysts
n32e28a20b7.summary: Analysts say the ruling party's strong showing in Singapore's general election signals a flight to safety and a vote for policy continuity, which Citi says supports investor confidence.
n32e28a20b7.why: Singapore is a major Asian financial hub, and political stability and policy continuity shape investor views of its banks and markets.

n64ad7fe287.headline: Iran Talks Tough and Launches Missile All While Seeking a New Nuclear Deal with the US
n64ad7fe287.summary: Iran says it wants a nuclear deal with the US, though talks scheduled in Rome last weekend did not take place. Iran has also launched a missile.
n64ad7fe287.why: Iran's nuclear programme and sanctions status shape Middle East risk premiums and global oil supply expectations.
